item.title: DHARMMA Strategic Framework
item.description:
The Challenge

The DHARMMA (Developing Higher Education’s Aspirations for Research in an Age of Mis- and Mal-information) network needed a unified vision to guide its multi-institutional efforts. We were tasked with facilitating a process to establish both short-term (1-2 year) and long-term (3-7 year) strategic goals.

Our Approach

We designed and facilitated a workshop centered on our Visions and Cascade Effects framework. This process guided network members to:

  1. Establish a Vision: Collaboratively define concrete short-term and long-term goals.
  2. Identify Obstacles & Catalysts: Brainstorm potential barriers and accelerators that could impact the vision.
  3. Analyze Cascade Effects: Map the secondary effects of each obstacle and catalyst to build resilient, adaptive strategies for institutionalizing their work.

The result was a comprehensive strategic roadmap that provided clarity and alignment for the entire network.
